external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Hola, em dic Elisa. Aquest estiu vaig estar a Barcelona i vaig treballar a ACJ YMCA, una associació voluntària per a persones amb problemes econòmics. En particular, vaig treballar amb nens de 4 a 7 anys. Encara que al final del dia estava molt cansada, em va agradar molt aquesta feina i va ser molt útil. M’agradaria donar les gràcies als Nexes i m’agradaria tornar a Espanya.

We have signed the Citizen Commitment for a Barcelona + Sustainable 2024-2034. Nexes joins the Barcelona + Sustainable Network, being part of a set of organizations and people committed to sustainability that, jointly and under the coordination of the Barcelona City Council, build a city responsible for society and the environment.

From 16 to 18 April, Lisbon hosted the Annual Meeting of the Migrantour Network, with the participation of 19 European cities from 7 countries. Local coordinators and intercultural companions met to share experiences, learn together and work for the future of the network. Back in Barcelona, Migrantour has joined the 5th Peace Week – Arcadi Oliveres, organized by Justícia i Pau. Under the motto “(Co)habitem en pau”, the week will be dedicated, in May, to intercultural diversity and the rights of migrants. Migrantour Barcelona will contribute with a double solidarity tourism route: a route through the Raval and another through Poble-sec, entitled “Cohabiting or coexisting?
